children: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings refinanced its balance sheet by issuing $950 million of 8.75% senior notes due 2031, expanding its revolving credit facility to $2.801 billion, and redeeming its 6.125% senior notes due 2028. Net proceeds of about $941.7 million from the new notes, plus cash, funded the 2028 notes redemption and repayments under the revolver and export-credit facilities. The amended revolver extends maturity to January 22, 2030, subject to springing conditions, and adjusts pricing by leverage. The moves enhance liquidity, push out maturities, and simplify capital structure.
Agreement 1: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Prices $950 Million 8.75% Senior Notes Due 2031
: 8.750% senior notes due 2031 issued under indenture
Agreement 2: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Expands Revolving Credit Facility to $2.801 Billion
: Third Amendment to Seventh Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (senior secured revolving loan facility)
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, as administrative agent, and lenders
: Through Jan 22 2030, subject to springing maturities
Agreement 3: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Redeems 6.125% 2028 Notes With Make-Whole Premium
: Redeemed using proceeds from new 2031 notes
